PageNotFoundHint: This page no longer exists or its address has changed.
PageErrorHint: Try again in a moment. If the problem persists, share the request ID below when reporting it.
AccountNotAssociated: This installation is not associated with an account yet.
AccountPending: Association started. Continue sign-in to finish linking this installation.
AccountDisconnectHint: Removes this machine from your account. Your local projects and linked GitHub or Google accounts are kept.
AccountAccessFailed: Account sign-in could not be completed. Check that this installation is associated with your account and that account two-factor authentication is enabled.
AccountRemoteAuthentication: Associate this installation with your account and enable two-factor authentication on my.kittyclaw.dev. This is the only authenticator you need.
AccountNetworkHint: Your KittyClaw account and its two-factor authentication protect both local network access and the Internet tunnel. There is no separate authenticator to set up on this machine.
AccountNetworkReady: Account two-factor authentication is enabled. Network connections use this same account.
AccountNetworkRequired: Associate this installation with your account and enable two-factor authentication on my.kittyclaw.dev. This is the only authenticator you need.
AccountNetworkEnableHint: Allow devices on your network to connect to this installation. They will sign in through your KittyClaw account. Restart KittyClaw once after activation to start the HTTPS listener.
AccessHintNetwork: From devices on the same network, using your account.
AccessHintInternet: From anywhere, through an HTTPS tunnel protected by your account.
AccessDnsHint: The tunnel and DNS address are created automatically. Leave the name empty for a generated address. The address stays reserved for this instance and cannot be renamed.
AccessConsentRequired: To enable Internet mode, allow the connection to pass through Cloudflare.
